{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-plugin-memory: a persistent 5-layer memory system plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — index+topics split, truncation budget, relevance injection, idle LLM auto-extraction, and 6 agent tools.","id":"gh:1337172310","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-memory","slug":"NattoCB/dsh-plugin-memory","topics":["ai-agent","cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","memory","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-plugin-memory: a persistent 5-layer memory system plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — index+topi"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"cs split, truncation budget, relevance injection, idle LLM auto-extraction, and 6 agent tools."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-memory"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Persistent five-layer memory for DeepSeek Harness: profile, project context, daily log, and recallab"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"le topics — so the agent remembers you across sessions, not just within one."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Two cordis seams — agent/pre-step injection + ctx.tools.register (six tools)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> A persistent five-layer memory system for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): a user profile (L1), a per-proje"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ct semantic index with topic files (L2), and append-only per-day logs (L3) under `~/.dsh/memory/` an"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"d `<cwd>/.dsh/memory/`. It injects relevant memories into every request and auto-extracts durable fa"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"cts from finished sessions via the LLM. Integrates as a DSH plugin on two cordis seams — `agent/pre-"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"step` for injection, `ctx.tools.register` for six `memory_*` agent tools. Without an `llm` route it "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"still works: entry injection, keyword relevance, and profile rotation remain; only LLM ranking and a"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"uto-extraction are disabled."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- 🧠 **Five-layer model**: L0 user-owned identity (`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md`, not managed by the plugin) → L"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"1 profile → L2 project index + topics → L3 per-day append-only log → L4 skills (existing). Each laye"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"r has its own write path, truncation budget, and injection rule.
- 📇 **Index + topic split (L2)**: `"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"MEMORY.md` is always an index of one-line pointers (≤150 chars each); details live in `<topic>.md`. "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"Keeps single files small, searchable, and truncatable.
- ✂️ **Truncation budget**: the booted index "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"is hard-clamped to 200 lines / 40,000 chars, so cold-start context stays cheap.
- 🎯 **Relevance inje"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ction**: on each step, the latest user query selects relevant topic files (LLM ranking when `llm` is"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" configured, keyword scoring otherwise) and appends them as a `<system-reminder data-role="memory">`"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" block; files already surfaced in this session are de-duplicated. The two channels are labeled `memo"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"ry-entry` (once per session) and `memory-relevance` (per step) in the GUI context rows.
- 🤖 **LLM au"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"to-extraction**: when a session goes idle, a debounced (60 s) best-effort pass scans the recent 40 e"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"vents, asks the LLM for new topic files and index lines, and writes them. Never overwrites existing "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"memories; degrades silently if the model is unavailable.
- 🔄 **Profile rotation (L1)**: `memory_prof"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"ile` merges new facts into four fixed sections (工作背景 / 个人背景 / 当前关注 / 近期动态) and rotates the version, "},{"id":"p8s15","text":"keeping the previous copy in `profile.md.bak`.
- 🔒 **Read-back data, not instructions**: memory is w"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"ritten with `fs/promises` directly to the memory roots — intended persistence, not self-modification"},{"id":"p8s17","text":" — and paths are confined to the store root. Memory files are context the agent reads back, never pe"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"rmission grants.
- 🧩 **Pure harness plugin**: no HTTP API or GUI panel — injection and tools only. D"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"SH serves a single user, so paths carry no `<uid>` layer.
- 🛠️ **Six agent tools** registered via `c"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"tx.tools.register` (`defineTool` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Tool | Scope | Effect |
|:-----|:------|:-------|
| `memory_write` | global/project | Write/overwr"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ite a topic file; optionally add an index line. |
| `memory_read` | global/project | Read a topic fi"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"le or the `MEMORY` index. |
| `memory_search` | global/project/both | Keyword-search topic files. |
"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"| `memory_daily` | cwd | Append a dated line to `<cwd>/.dsh/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md`. |
| `memory_forge"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"t` | global/project | Delete a topic file and its index pointer. |
| `memory_profile` | global | Rea"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"d, or merge-and-rotate, the single-user profile. |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Quick Start"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Prerequisites"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) installation with a plugin-capable profile (e.g. `web`).
- No LLM route r"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"equired — the plugin falls back to keyword-only relevance."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Run"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Restart `dsh web`. On first use the plugin bootstraps both memory roots:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Tell the agent something worth remembering, or let idle auto-extraction pick it up — then check the "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"memory roots a session later."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Deploy the plugin via a DSH bundle entry (see `cordis.patch.yml` and `package.json` `exports`):"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |
|:----|:--------|:--------|
| `enableEntryInjection` | `true` | Prepend "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"the how-to-save + index block once per session. |
| `enableRelevance` | `true` | Append relevant top"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ic files per step (`data-role=memory`). |
| `enableExtraction` | `true` | Idle-time LLM auto-extract"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ion. |
| `maxRelevant` | `5` | Max files surfaced per step (1–20). |
| `relevanceTopK` | `8` | Max c"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"andidates the LLM selector may pick from (1–40). |
| `relevanceBudgetChars` | `2000` | Per-topic cha"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"r cap fed to relevance selection (≥200). |
| `extractionDebounceMs` | `60000` | Idle debounce before"},{"id":"p21s7","text":" an extraction pass runs. |
| `extractionLookback` | `40` | Recent events scanned per pass (5–200). "},{"id":"p21s8","text":"|
| `llm.provider` | `""` | Provider for extraction / relevance ranking (empty → keyword-only). |
| "},{"id":"p21s9","text":"`llm.model` | `""` | Model for extraction / relevance ranking. |
| `llm.maxTokens` | `1024` | Comple"},{"id":"p21s10","text":"tion token cap for LLM calls. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Example entry:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Open an issue · Source"}],"truncated":false}
